messages.content: Compare River Valley, Sunset Resort, and Jungle Camp on price, amenities, and how easy it is to book them.

I'd be happy to compare River Valley, and Jungle Camp for you. Unfortunately, I couldn't find any information on Sunset Resort in our search results. 

Let's start with the price: River Valley costs 6701 INR per person per day, while Jungle Camp costs 6044 INR per person per day. So, Jungle Camp is the more budget-friendly option.

In terms of amenities, both resorts offer WiFi, restaurants, and parking. However, River Valley has more on-site activities like campfire, nature walk, bird watching, and yoga, whereas Jungle Camp has a pool and offers coracle rides as a water activity. River Valley also has more room options, including Standard Tent and Deluxe Cottage.

As for booking, both resorts have a website and contact information. You can book River Valley by visiting https://www.rivervalley.com, calling +91 9959489786, or emailing booking@rivervalley.com. For Jungle Camp, you can visit https://www.junglecamp.com, call +91 9901340067, or email booking@junglecamp.com. They seem to be equally easy to book.

Overall, the choice between River Valley and Jungle Camp depends on your priorities. If you're looking for a more luxurious experience with a wider range of activities, River Valley might be the better choice. However, if you're on a tighter budget and still want a great jungle experience, Jungle Camp could be the way to go.
